module_summary: Clock-domain-crossing data transfer: source-domain registers capture a 4-bit word and a valid flag, the flag passes through a two-flop synchronizer in the destination clock, and the synchronized flag loads the held word into the output register.

anchors.why: Source data input captured in the source clock domain.

anchors.name: n10_6fb
anchors.why: Source valid/enable flag that is synchronized to the destination domain.

anchors.name: n8_f97
anchors.why: Source-domain registered valid flag feeding the synchronizer.

anchors.name: n11_347
anchors.why: Synchronizer output stage; enables the destination data register load.
